video_title: Draymond Green Show LIVE: AJ Dybantsa, Dominique Wilkins & Tiffany Haddish At Fanatics Fest

quotes.speaker: Dominique Wilkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Dominique Wilkins on the development of AJ Dybantsa in Washington
quotes.excerpt: you got two all-star veterans there in Trey Young and AD, guys who've been there, who've done it

text_blocks.speaker: Draymond Green
text_blocks.text: How much of it is on him to insert himself as a leader, as the guy, but yet and still knowing, what's the balance in knowing that you have AD and you have Trey Young there, but you're looked at to turn the franchise around?

text_blocks.speaker: Dominique Wilkins
text_blocks.text: Well, the first thing is you got two all-star veterans there in Trey Young and AD, guys who've been there, who've done it. Trey, who's a great passer, makes sure you get the rock, that's for sure. But as a young man coming in, especially a guy who was highly sought after, you just got to come and be yourself.

text_blocks.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
text_blocks.text: I mean, that's what I'm coming in to do. Now, they've been loyal to us, so they deserve it.

quotes.speaker: Dominique Wilkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Dominique Wilkins names his top five high-flyers of all time
quotes.excerpt: I always start with Dr. J because he's the granddaddy of us all. That's who I grew up wanting to be like
quotes.quote: I always start with Dr. J because he's the granddaddy of us all. That's who I grew up wanting to be like. So definitely, he's on that list. I would say Vince Carter, definitely. Vince Carter. I like to have myself on there, too. I got to put myself on there. I think I put myself on there. Michael Jordan is definitely in there. And again, that's a great question because there's so many guys that's worthy of that title. If I had to go with the days, one of the guys from to this era, it would be Blake Griffin. Blake Griffin, he was a power dunker, he could really fly. But if I had to throw a couple of armaments in it, it would be Clyde Drexler and Shawn Kemp. There was some high-flyers, man, but some special talent there. So it's hard for me to pick five because there's so many guys that's worthy of that title.

quotes.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa on his recruitment pitch to LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: My pitch is talk to AD. That's a good pitch. That is a good pitch. They won a championship together.
quotes.quote: My pitch is talk to AD. That's a good pitch. That is a good pitch. They won a championship together.

text_blocks.speaker: Draymond Green
text_blocks.text: What's your pitch to LeBron? You're trying to get LeBron to Washington, everybody's trying to get LeBron. What's your pitch?

text_blocks.speaker: AJ Dybantsa
text_blocks.text: My pitch is talk to AD.

text_blocks.speaker: Draymond Green
text_blocks.text: That's a good pitch. That is a good pitch. They won a championship together.

quotes.speaker: Tiffany Haddish
quotes.summary_phrase: Tiffany Haddish on the business side of her career
quotes.excerpt: I just do what the front office tells me to do. You know, they want me to shut down
quotes.quote: I just do what the front office tells me to do. You know, they want me to shut down, get ready for training camp. I mean, he wants to play, he can play. There ain't nothing wrong with playing, there ain't nothing wrong with the team shutting you down. In my opinion.

quotes.speaker: Tiffany Haddish
quotes.summary_phrase: Tiffany Haddish on using comedy to process trauma
quotes.excerpt: I use comedy as a defense mechanism and it's a way to heal, it's a way to process trauma
quotes.quote: I use comedy as a defense mechanism and it's a way to heal, it's a way to process trauma. If you ever pay attention to comedy, there's always somebody that gets hurt in a joke. It's always some, either whether it be yourself, it's self-deprecating, or somebody else, or a group, or whatever. It's always some kind of pain there, and we have to learn how to laugh about it if you want to heal. Like, if you want to heal from any trauma, you got to learn how to laugh about it. Once you find the funny, find the joy in it, find the lesson in it, you'll find a blessing and you'll heal from it.

quotes.speaker: Tiffany Haddish
quotes.summary_phrase: Tiffany Haddish on the business of filmmaking
quotes.excerpt: We shot that movie February of last year in Detroit in Barry Gordy's old house
quotes.quote: We shot that movie February of last year in Detroit in Barry Gordy's old house. So that was kind of cool, and there was like pictures of Michael Jackson all around and stuff. The guy that bought the house kept like a lot of the like things that were in there, and so that was fun, and I feel like it's haunt, that place was definitely haunted. But the filmmaking process, it usually takes like a year for the film to come out, two to three months to shoot the movie, and then the editing process, and you know, all that stuff that voiceovers and, you know, how they're going to market it and everything, and then boom, it's out in theaters. And I don't like the new way of things where the movie comes out in theaters for like a week and then it's streaming, which I think is taking away from people having experiences.

quotes.speaker: Tiffany Haddish
quotes.summary_phrase: Tiffany Haddish on the importance of asking questions in business
quotes.excerpt: I've learned to ask a lot more questions and I make sure I cannot meet, can I meet these people
quotes.quote: I've learned to ask a lot more questions and I make sure I cannot meet, can I meet these people? I want to meet all the producers, I want to meet all, I want to meet everybody because I want to know who I'm in business with, because that's what I had to learn back in 2014, and that's what got me the Girls Trip and helped me build relationships. I learned to build relationships and and if they don't believe in me, then I don't want to be a part of it.
